newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet differentials stable, trade inactive.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet differentials stable, trade inactive.

text.p: NWE jet fuel differentials were steady and outright prices eased but spot physical business was inactive on Monday, traders said.
Outright values shed $1.75 a tonne, in line with September IPE gas oil futures which closed at $169.25.
Buying appeared limited to contango storage, traders said. Barge differentials were assessed at around September IPE +$17, at parity with cargo spread values.
EU qualified jet was assessed notionally at $6 to $7 over fob Med high quotations.
